doc.title: Wendy Oxenhorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 22, 2026

title: Handing over the Foundation and counselling musicians now
summary: She explains the board urged her to hand it over, and that she still counsels musicians and refers them to Alisa and Joe Petrucelli.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Okay, because I know you have other questions. But I ended up, so after this was sort of taken out of my hands it was like the beginning of the pandemic and there was such a need – I was having ten musicians a day calling me so of course I want you to know that musicians still call me and I still counsel and I’m still there for them, and now if it becomes issues with money I’ll counsel them and soothe the soul but then I will hand them over of course to our head angel Alisa at the Jazz Foundation, you know, who is head of the social work department and they take care of the rent, they take care of their doctors.
